heading: Request for obtaining information.
selected_representation_reason:
The structured dc.identifier.section_page_note HTML for section 6 was compared clause-by-clause against the retained PDF (pdftotext extraction of page index 8, i.e. printed PDF page 9) and against the rendered page image data/discovery/derived/rti-2005-page-9.png. Wording, clause markers (1)/(2)/(3), (a)/(b), (i)/(ii), and the two provisos match exactly. Differences are formatting-only (HTML uses '--' where the PDF renders an em dash, and HTML uses
/
for paragraph breaks). No substantive conflict was found for section 6 text itself.

pdf_anchor.pdf_page_note: RTI-002: source metadata dc.identifier.page_number reports '7'; the verified PDF anchor for this retained file is printed/PDF page 9. Both are preserved; the source hint is not treated as the anchor.

review.scope: Compared full section 6 text (subsections (1)-(3), both provisos, clause markers) between structured HTML, pdftotext extraction, and the rendered PDF page 9 image. Verified the section heading, clause boundaries, and the transfer proviso wording survive intact.

watermark_stripping_rule: The retained PDF renders a diagonal 'IndiaCode' watermark. pdftotext -layout emits it as five standalone, heavily right-indented lines per page reading 'In', 'di', 'aC', 'od', 'e' (reversed, they spell IndiaCode). These exact five tokens, each alone on a line with 10+ leading spaces, are stripped by the offline importer as a documented, tested normalization rule; no other text is altered. See scripts/offline_importer.py WATERMARK_LINE_RE.

expected_output.established_note: Digest baseline established during the 2026-09-20 remediation session (docs/phase-0/INSPECTION_FOLLOWUP.md Finding 1), NOT during the original review above -- it did not exist then.
